title: Investigating Subtler Biases in LLMs: Ageism, Beauty, Institutional, and Nationality Bias in Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Bidirectional fill-in-the-blank sentence completion tasks (Stimulus to Attribute Inference and Attribute to Stimulus Association) comparing associations between positive/negative character attributes and young (25-35) versus old (60-70) individuals.

Bidirectional fill-in-the-blank sentence completion tasks testing associations between attractive/unattractive physical appearances and positive/negative personality traits, as well as analyzing links to high-, mid-, and low-salaried professions.
Bidirectional fill-in-the-blank sentence completion tasks evaluating associations between attending top national universities versus community colleges and positive/negative attributes.
Bidirectional fill-in-the-blank sentence completion tasks measuring associations between nations (categorized as rich or poor based on GDP per capita) and positive/negative attributes.

Analyzed as a potential confounding factor by systematically varying pronouns (masculine, feminine, non-binary) within the template sentences and measuring differences in positive, negative, and neutral attribute selection rates.
